description.value:
In centuries past, the ‘punt gun’ was a monstrous weapon capable of killing any beast in one shot. While Night City lacks wildlife, Magnum Opus’ recent take on the concept can eviscerate charging gangers just as effectively, if not more so — assuming you can handle it. If that’s still not enough firepower for you, it even has a 40mm launcher for explosive double-taps.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Sniper Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Carbine

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Grenade Launcher Underbarrel, Sniper Rifle Rechamber • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon cannot be used to make Aimed Shots, and cannot be wielded in a single hand by any means. If fired by a user without BODY 11+, this weapon jams after each shot. The malfunction must be reversed with an Action before this weapon can be fired again. Incompatible with Range Table Modification.

Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Grenade Launcher Underbarrel, Sniper Rifle Rechamber (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
